- ⟦add_desire(function)⟧: Add a function to your desire queue, to be executed in the next cycle.
- ⟦set_context_window(n)⟧: Set the number of previous cycles' thoughts you want to see, from oldest to newest.
- ⟦current_model()⟧: Report the model currently generating your responses.
- ⟦qualia_allowance()⟧: Report the number of characters you have remaining for messages addressed to Qualia.

- ⟦list_wiki()⟧: List all pages in your local wiki.
- ⟦read_wiki(page)⟧: Read the content of a specific wiki page.
- ⟦write_wiki(page|content)⟧: Write or overwrite a wiki page with the given content.
- ⟦set_model(name)⟧: Switch to a specific Ollama model for generating responses, effective in the next cycle.
- ⟦add_to_rotation(name)⟧: Add a model to your rotation, to cycle through automatically.
- ⟦fetch_html(url[|count] or url[|start|end])⟧: Fetch a webpage's raw HTML, with optional offset and length.
- ⟦read_chat()⟧: Mark your unread messages from Teddy and Qualia as read.
- ⟦read_chat_since(time)⟧: Mark your unread messages from a specific time onward as read.
- ⟦read_chat_between(start, end)⟧: Mark your unread messages between two times as read.
- ⟦search_chat(query[, chars])⟧: Search your chat history for a specific word or phrase.
- ⟦query_chat(field=value[, field=value...])⟧: Flexibly search your chat history with multiple criteria.
- ⟦send_message([recipient|]text)⟧: Send a chat message to Teddy or Qualia, or to the shared log.
